requirement.description: The Memory.Init class constructor has incorrect handling of MemoryData.Init objects and doesn't properly validate the type of the initialization data, causing test failures in MemoryTestCase.test_constructor and MemoryTestCase.test_constructor_shapecastable.

contract.description: The Memory.Init constructor should properly accept and handle MemoryData.Init objects passed as the 'items' parameter, and should validate that the initialization data conforms to the expected shape and type.

exception.condition: Memory depth must be a non-negative integer

requirement.description: The MemoryData.Init class constructor incorrectly handles MemoryData.Init objects passed to it, and lacks proper validation of initialization data.

contract.description: The MemoryData.Init constructor should properly accept MemoryData.Init objects and handle them appropriately, and should validate that the initialization data conforms to the expected shape and type.

requirement.description: The SwitchValue and DuplicateElaboratable classes are not properly exposed in the public API, causing NameError exceptions in various tests.

contract.description: SwitchValue and DuplicateElaboratable classes should be properly defined and accessible in the amaranth.hdl._ir module.

requirement.description: Error message format inconsistency in signature validation, expecting backticks around parameter names but getting unquoted versions.

contract.description: Memory signature validation error messages should consistently format parameter names with backticks to match expected test output.

exception.condition: Address width must be a non-negative integer

requirement.description: RTLIL backend generates incomplete output for certain operators, missing closing 'end' statements causing test failures.

contract.description: RTLIL backend should properly generate complete and valid RTLIL output for all operators, including proper closing statements.
